## Coffee and pastries (my top recommendations)

I have recently been very into cinnamon rolls and I love to go out for coffee or tea in the mornings! Here are my top places at home and at school.

### Pasadena

Badash Bakes- matcha and classic cinnamon rolls ![Badash Bakes](images/badash.png)

Jones Coffee- home of my favorite chai latte ever! ![Jones Coffee](images/jones.png)

### Santa Barbara

Brass Bird- my current favorite cinnamon roll, accompanied by a cinnamon roll latte and a strawberry matcha latte (all delicious) ![brass bird](images/brass-bird-rolls.png) ![](images/brass-bird-bevs.JPG)
